children: Boot Barn expects second-quarter total sales and EPS at the high end of previously provided guidance after posting 2% same-store sales growth in fiscal August.
Announced participation in Goldman Sachs and Piper Sandler investor conferences (Sept 15–16) with live webcasts.
Reported 2% same-store sales growth in fiscal August and similar pace in early September.
Reaffirmed prior same-store sales guidance for Q2; expect same-store sales to finish within range.
Now expect total Q2 sales and EPS to be at the high end of previously announced guidance ranges.
Webcasts and 90-day archives available at investor.bootbarn.com for investor access.
